critique: The render reads unambiguously as an FPGA NTT accelerator floorplan: open butterfly-array frame with 8 distinct copper multiplier lanes and symmetric add/sub blocks, 8 interleaved blue BRAM banks with input/output FIFOs on the -X edge, the conflict-free crossbar spine, layered+arrowed read/twiddle/return buses, the exploded radix-4 cutaway, and the raised exploded heatsink that (after last pass) no longer blankets the twiddle ROM, addr-gen or schedule blocks in the TOP plan view. The single remaining render-grounded defect was the shared Barrett reduction spine (mod_red_mult cylinder + mod_red_subshift box) sitting at the same height as the +X pipeline-register column, so in ISO the two reduction members partly merged into the register row; this pass lifts the spine and pulls the register column -X so both reduction members now read distinctly in the X-ray. The only items still imperfect (paper Sec.III bank()/offset() map, per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s, rearranged-loop twiddle addressing, exact FSM table, and the bit-reversed-ROM-vs-natural-order tension) are source-bound: the CFNTT PDF body is FlateDecode-undecodable, so they are correctly labelled [conv]/[source-missing] in the spec and cannot be made paper-faithful inside this visual loop — no achievable scene change is worth >2 points.
changelog: Lifted the shared Barrett reduction spine so it reads clear of the pipeline-register column in the ISO X-ray: mod_red_mult cylinder y 0.95->1.1 (top ~1.6, just under the return bus at 1.62) and mod_red_subshift box y 0.85->1.0 (top ~1.45), closing the last render-grounded occlusion noted in the carried-over reflection

Pulled the eight pipeline registers -X (x 1.5->1.3) to open ~0.15 m more horizontal separation between the register column and the reduction spine while staying clear of the add/sub blocks (end x~1.05) and the array/reduction floorplan partition (x 1.95)

Reworded the mod_red_mult / mod_red_subshift roles to state the spine is elevated so both reduction members stay legible above the register row in the X-ray (annotation kept consistent with the new geometry; Barrett mu/k/op semantics unchanged)
